_comment: Background sub-agent notices and hand-backs (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-agent-notices-design.md). Read by the Mac MightyCore AgentNoticeTests and the Windows Core checks. Shapes follow Claude Code records; IDs and text are made up. A stream's expect.mainNoticeSections lists each notice turn's answer the main result must hold, under the line built from its locale key (and title); agentLogLacks lists text the block's log must not hold.
